# sq-72 — The $id rule: patch releases keep the tag, and prereleases

`Schema_Id_NamesTheTagThatFirstWroteTheSchema` (tests/squalify.Tests/Schema/SchemaValueTests.cs, `IdTagIsRight`) returns true for any `$id` unless the patch is 0 and major.minor equals `schemaVersion`, so nothing rejects `$id` v1.0.1 in a 1.0.1 release, which the rule forbids ("a release that leaves the schema as it is keeps the `$id` of the release that first wrote it"). Surviving mutants: the `core.Length != 3` guard and the prerelease split have no case. Also decide what a prerelease of a schema-changing minor does: as written a `1.1.0-rc.1` that writes schema 1.1 must name `v1.1.0-rc.1`, and the final 1.1.0 must edit `$id` again, which contradicts docs/release.md step 1. Add the assertion (1.0.1 with `$id` v1.0.1 fails), cases for a prerelease, align the helper and release.md.
